cohort: The study included 426 postpartum women attending Rwamagana Hospital.
finding: The prevalence of Cesarean section at Rwamagana Hospital was 38%, with younger maternal age, fetal malposition, no labour experience, and primiparity being positively associated, while previous vaginal birth was negatively associated with CS.
mod_finding: The study identified several factors associated with cesarean section delivery, including maternal age, fetal malposition, labor experience, and parity, which collectively influence the mode of birth.
